findings.title: Paginated/filtered getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference potentially null modelSupplier.get()
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` was updated to guard against `modelSupplier.get()` returning `null` when the group has been concurrently deleted from the database while still present in cache. However, the three `getSubGroupsStream` overloads right above it (lines 256, 262, and 268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly without a null check. Under the same concurrent deletion scenario, calling any of those methods on a cached `GroupAdapter` will still throw a `NullPointerException` instead of returning `Stream.empty()`.

findings.title: Background reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is not joined before asserting or finishing the test
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the background thread started at line 139 is never joined after `deletedAll.set(true)` at line 155. As a result, an in-flight `groups(...)` request that fails right as the last group is deleted can add its exception to `caughtExceptions` after `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` has already passed, causing false positives, and the still-running request can also race with subsequent tests or test cleanup on `managedRealm`. Store the `Thread` reference and `join()` it before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.
